data.title: Odd usernames get through sign-up
story: A username may only contain letters and digits, and must not be empty. But usernames like "budi 123" and "a<b>" are accepted.
Fix the function valid_username so it checks EVERY character.

explanation: The old code answers True as soon as it finds one valid character, so the rest is never checked. The right way: reject as soon as one character is invalid, and answer True only after every character passes.
hints: Try valid_username("b!!") and print the result. How many characters are really checked?
Flip the logic: return False when you find a character that is NOT a letter or digit.
Do not forget empty text: check len(name) == 0 at the start.
